-----insert data in om tasks table
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks SELECT 'TSK_EDS_LNS_LADMD','EDS','EDS','LNS_LADMD','LNS',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SCD TYPE 2';GO
INSERT INTO om.om_tasks SELECT 'TSK_STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD','EDS_STG','D360','STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD','LNS',NULL,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime),NULL,'WEEKDAYS','SCD TYPE 2';GO


-----insert data in om task dependency table 
INSERT INTO om.om_task_dependency SELECT (SELECT MAX(ISNULL(DEPENDENCY_ID,0)) FROM om.om_task_dependency) + 1,'TSK_STG_EDS_LNS_LADMD','TSK_EDS_LNS_LADMD',NULL; GO
